DESIGN-06.action: Optional: ensure design-detail-page renders an upload affordance on the default tab or add a stable data-testid like design-detail-upload.

DOC-06.evidence: ?view=document-center renders 'Pusat Dokumen' with 178 testids; search for nonsense string produces Indonesian empty-state text ('tidak ada'/'belum ada'/'kosong').

Top-level page has a general search input but no element matching placeholder /scan|pindai/i. However, 'Barang Masuk (SJ & OCR)' and 'Scan Terima PO (sisa lama)' sub-tabs exist and are the actual scan entry points.
INV-06.action: Optional: add data-testid='wms-scan-input' or a 'pindai' placeholder on the SJ & OCR scanner input so smoke tests can detect it directly.

QC-06.evidence: ?view=qc / inspection / quality-control all fall into WMS 'Operasi Gudang (WMS)' which exposes an 'Inspeksi QC' tab and 'SPK Inspeksi & QC' tab. 234 testids, no errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Supplier 360, Catalog, and Bank account history tabs follow the exact same AuditHistoryPanel contract (testIdPrefix pattern <prefix>-row-<id>, -from-<field>, -to-<field>, -integrity, -layer, -empty, -only-changes, -refresh) — consistent and testable.
Permission gating (`canAudit` on frontend + 403 on backend audit-logs/resource) is correctly applied: sales@ sees neither supplier-360-tab-changes nor catalog-tab-history. Good defense in depth.

GL/Finance URL slug sprawl: ?view=gl-journal, ?view=financial-reports, ?view=gl-reports all silently fall back to Control Tower instead of 404-ing — this hurts discoverability for both humans and automated UAT. Consider either routing them to general-ledger or showing an explicit 'unknown view' hint.
